title: Io Galileo SSI / Voyager Color Merged Global Mosaic 1km
reusePolicy: USGS-authored or produced data are generally U.S. Public Domain; proper credit requested. Review USGS copyrights-and-credits guidance and any item-specific notice before reuse.
sourceNotes: Galileo SSI color ratios are superimposed on higher-resolution monochrome Voyager/Galileo imagery.
Surface appearance changed between source eras; resolution, coverage, phase angle, and illumination vary.
The product page reports no color-mosaic coverage within about 5 degrees of either pole and says polar areas were interpolated in the merged mosaic.
The north-edge all-zero row in the downloaded GeoTIFF was filled from its adjacent row for the runtime derivative.
